propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep executes one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, blocking all writers for minutes; deployed reality is worse since per-ticket map misses fall through to per-event wildcard walks defeating pathspec pruning.

The authorship ledger builder should use position-keyed build_position_commit_map (walks history once) instead of per-ticket directory-scoped walks; a path-keyed sibling would miss every lookup and silently restore per-event walks.
The _commit_backfill staging with git add -A can sweep a concurrent writer's uncommitted event files into the compaction commit instead of staging only folded paths.
The sweep loop never re-yields mid-run to re-probe write_lock_is_busy between tickets, so writers arriving after the sweep starts wait for the entire run to complete.
After implementation, the position map must return None (not empty dict) on builder failure to degrade to per-ticket walks rather than per-event walks inside the lock.
